page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.7xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance belonging to the ecs.gn5 family. It is equipped with 28 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, featuring 14 physical cores with hyper-threading. The hardware configuration includes 112 GB of RAM, a single NVIDIA P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM, and 472 GB of local SSD storage. Network connectivity is supported by a 5 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance split between CPU-bound and GPU-accelerated workloads. Single-core CPU performance is limited, with stress-ng single-core and single-threaded compression tests scoring in the bottom 10% and bottom 25% respectively. However, multi-core CPU performance, Passmark CPU scores, and memory bandwidth fall into the average tier. Crucially, the integrated NVIDIA P100 GPU enables top-tier performance in LLM inference, achieving top 10% results for prompt processing on both 135M and 7B models, as well as text generation on the 7B model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a balanced resource density for legacy GPU workloads, combining dedicated compute cores, local SSD storage, and hardware acceleration without the premium cost of newer-generation GPU architectures. It is best suited for workloads such as medium-scale machine learning inference, data parallel processing, database operations, and static web serving, where multi-threaded CPU execution and GPU acceleration can offset the weaker single-core performance.
